articles.summary: We asked the answering model to file its own paperwork through a mandatory tool, and smaller models showed us the cost. Moving that work to a separate call after the reply fixed it.
articles.title: Why our agents classify each turn after they answer

articles.title: Sovereign AI for public services: running open models on infrastructure you own
